notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to it.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.
